maddeler.e:
اختلسوا (form VIII)
# اِخْتَلَسُوا (iḵtalasū) /ix.ta.la.suː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِخْتَلَسَ (iḵtalasa)
# اُخْتُلِسُوا (uḵtulisū) /ux.tu.li.suː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِخْتَلَسَ (iḵtalasa)
# اِخْتَلِسُوا (iḵtalisū) /ix.ta.li.suː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِخْتَلَسَ (iḵtalasa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
